description: Append the next ordered chunk of an open stage. part starts at 1 and increases by one. The same part with the same bytes is a no-op. A different byte string, a skipped part, or a chunk over 16000 characters is refused and the current document is unchanged.

chunk.description: The next slice of the document, at most 16000 characters. Chunks are concatenated in order at commit.

exchange.description: The exchange (turn) this write belongs to, counting from 1. A write for exchange n while exchange n-1 was never appended is refused by the session graph until n-1 is appended.

part.description: The 1-based part index. The next part is next_part from the previous call. A whole number sent as text is accepted.

session_id.description: Your transcript session id from emet_session_open. The session graph reads this session's state before the write and returns `session_graph.next` - the next step. A governed write with no session is refused (open one with emet_session_open and load_id).

source.description: Source tag. Must be the same source the stage was begun with.

name: write_doc_append
